# Clay

Clay is a go-to-market data enrichment and workflow automation platform for searching people and companies, running routines, and querying workspace tables.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/clay/.

## Actions

- **Continue Search**: Consume one next page from an existing Clay query-mode search.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Return the Clay user and workspace associated with the connected Public API key.
- **Get Routine Run Results** (read-only): Check progress or fetch one page of results for an existing inline Clay routine run.
- **Get Search Query Reference** (read-only): Return Clay's current advanced-search field and grammar reference for composing people or company queries.
- **Run Routine**: Start a Clay routine for 1-100 items, poll it for a bounded time, and return completed item results or the current run ID and progress.
- **Search People or Companies**: Create a Clay query-mode people or company search and consume its first result page.
